avis.titre: Similar to the M&M Blackberry Idebenone cream; great product from an underrated brandSimilar to the M&M Blackberry Idebe
avis.texte: First let me state that I LOVE Rovectin but they seem to be largely overlooked in the K-beauty community and I'm not sure why. Their Lotus Water Cream is one of the greatest products ever made for sensitive skin, and all of their products I've tried (including serums and facial oil) are gentle, effective, and wonderful for sensitive skin. This holds true for this cream as well, which is a sensitive-skin friendly version of a brightening cream. SO many pros for this cream: fragrance-free, soothing, vitamin-fortified, a gentle vitamin C derivative for those who react poorly to active forms, lightweight but moisturizing, absorbs SUPER fast even for "difficult" skin like mine, zero irritation. It's not greasy or sticky or heavy. It feels great going on and is so light you forget it is there. My ideal formula for a cream. It's manufactured by Kolmar Korea, which is one of the top two K-beauty manufacturers. As I mentioned above, it is SUPER moisturizing, which is GREAT for my dry, dehydrated skin but might be a bit much for oilier skin types. If that is you, I would recommend this more as a night cream, especially if you use sunscreen daily (as you now must because you are using a vitamin C cream). The brightening effects will take approximately 1-3 months to be super noticeable, but you can sometimes notice slight fading after a few weeks. You will get better results pairing this with a brightening serum (the one in this line or another). This formulation will help reduce dark sp

avis.titre: I was not expecting how good Rovectin is...I was not expecting how good Rovectin is...
avis.texte: This Rovectin brightening and toning cream is fantastic. Since it helps with unevenness and dark spots, I started by testing it on my arms to help regenerate skin that has seen way too much lawn mowing. But this cream is so good that I now exclusively use it on my face, where it is slowly but surely brightening my fair skin and reducing any redness and just helping for an overall more even complexion. I've been using it after cleansing in place of a serum, followed by moisturizer. But it is so hydrating that it could be used alone. I also think it's a good value since the formula is high-quality and potent, and it comes in a tube that allows you to use it all (as opposed to a glass bottle) and just a little goes a long way.

avis.titre: Skin felt taut after useSkin felt taut after use
avis.texte: Review for Double Toning Cream from ROVECTIN: This is between a cream, lotion, and serum. It has no artificial scent to it, which is appreciated. It applied evenly to my skin but did feel just a little tacky afterwards. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and I noticed it turned slightly red, but did not itch or burn. I felt, based on the way my skin felt somewhat taut afterwards that it may be more of a toner, than is it a moisturizing your skin a lot. I was concerned of how long this particular tube had been sitting, as the tape on the lid was old and left a sticky mark... plus numerous scratches made me wonder where it had been. (see pic) There is no expiration date on the item, unless it is in Korean, which I can't read. As far as the value for your money... at $26 for a somewhat small amount, I'm not sure of the value I got. Only time will tell if this makes any difference in my skin.

avis.titre: Underrated, great value - PLANT BASED PDRN (no fish semen!)
avis.texte: I found this in my quest to understand why Korean beauty (aka K-Beauty) is so popular. I'm in my early 40s and perimenopausal. My skim is unpredictable (matching my hormones in general) but seems fixated on staying in sensitive, breakout-prone, dry skin mode. I have been intrigued by PDRN but refuse to support the collection and use of fish semen in this way - it feels unethical and also just... ick. So, I appreciate that this is plant-derived PDRN which maybe won't be as magical but research indicates it's still beneficial. It applies thin but feels good - not a lingering sticky/tacky feel as I worried. I played around with timing over the past few weeks and it fits into my morning routine best, although I'm inconsistent since I'm a busy mom and when I run late my routine gets drastically simplified (all this week in fact I was makeup free at work too!). I think this is an underrated product as it packs a punch for a value price - and if you've seen prices for mainstream skincare at big box stores lately, this is well within average range (lower end even for many). Patch test first but even my sensitive skin has been fine with it. It's not going to bring a heavy moisturize load, but you can layer products so play around with your skin and routine to see how it works out best! It is scented but pretty light and doesn't linger.

avis.titre: Not strong enough for drier skin, but overall good productNot strong enough for drier skin, but overall good product
avis.texte: I tried this two ways and had better results when keeping my previous moisturizer in use and just adding this one. Using this as my main moisturizer didn’t work well for me, but I do have dry skin. So I do like the product, it just can’t replace anything for me at this point. The instructions say to use this as your final skincare step and I felt like even being at the end this absorbed really well. There is a mild scent and the consistency is a bit more gel than cream. This seems to be a high quality product and didn’t break me out when I added it to my routine, which has happened even with great products in the past. In my case though I only noticed very minor changes to my skin. I don’t have dark spots but I do have a lot of red undertones and splotchiness and it did seem to help with that a little. So while I think this is a good product, I don’t think it’s going to be a repurchase based on my skin needs. I will finish it though to be sure. I think $25.99 is a decent price for this if it works well for you, probably for folks with oilier skin than mine. Overall I would recommend trying it.

avis.titre: Good moisturizer for sensitive skinGood moisturizer for sensitive skin
avis.texte: ROVECTIN's Vita Double Toning Cream is a very good skin care product that offers moisturizing and anti-aging benefits. As another reviewer noted, Rovectin is a K-beauty brand that doesn't receive the attention it deserves. I've tried a few of their products now, and I've come away impressed by every single one. This cream is no exception. I have sensitive skin; I have rosacea, and fragrance tends to give me headaches and make my eyes itch. Thus, I have to be very careful about the skincare products I use. This cream was a hit for as soon as I saw that there was no added fragrance. Overall, the ingredient list is packed with ingredients that have anti-aging, soothing, and moisturizing properties, including ascorbic acid, adenosine, and antioxidants, among many others. I ran the ingredient list through Beautypedia, and almost all of the ingredients were rated as excellent or good, with only a few "average" ingredients. No ingredients were rated below average or poor. It's too soon to know if this product is effective at fading dark spots and balancing skin tone, because those effects take weeks (if not months) to observe). However, what I can say after a week of use is that this product applies beautifully. It feels silky upon application, glides easily over the skin, and absorbs quickly, without any stickiness. I have had no issues with pilling. Overall, I am very happy with this order and believe it offers good value for the money.

avis.titre: Really nice skincare!Really nice skincare!
avis.texte: Rovectin Vita Double Toning Cream This is a nice quality serum. It's a white cream with no smell - so no added colors or fragrances, which is a sign of quality skincare. The bottle has a nice pump that only dispenses a little at a time, which is all you should need for a high-end serum. My skin feels moisturized and soft after use. And it doesn't feel sticky, so I can apply makeup on top of the serum. I have moderately sensitive skin and had no reaction. My skin likes it. The tube is printed mostly in Korean, but the box is in English. It highlights ingredients like Vitamin Tree Water, Niaminicide, Ethyl Ascorbyl Ether, and Glutathione. It also says it is rich in Vitamin C. It suggests applying twice a day to reduce dark spots and brighten the skin. I fed the ingredients into a skincare analyzer, and they all were rated as good or great. Niacinamide, a great active ingredient, is listed second. But I would prefer it if they listed exactly what percentage of each active ingredient, so I know what I'm paying for. I haven't used it long enough to see the brightening aspects, but I've used similar serums in the past and have had results. And Korean skincare has a great reputation. The expiration date is over 3 years in the future. It says the company was founded to help restore skin after chemotherapy!

avis.titre: Lightweight, fresh, absorbs well with slight stickiness.Lightweight, fresh, absorbs well with slight stickiness.
avis.texte: I've been using ROVECTIN Vita Double Toning Cream for the past 10 days. It's a lightweight, pale yellow cream that has a very faint floral scent. This cream has been spreading easily and absorbing quickly on my combination skin. I've had no greasiness, but it does cause my skin to feel slightly sticky. So far, my temperamental skin seems to like this cream! It's formulated for sensitive skin, and it has been working well from that perspective. I'm interested in seeing what it does with my dark spots and skin tone after longer use. I like that this product's packaging is an airless pump, which will help keep it fresh. The expiry date on mine is 6/28, which is excellent. Right now, this is approx $26 here on Amazon, which I think is a good value for 1.69 oz. Another nice product from Korea!

avis.titre: Lightweight, multi-function cream
avis.texte: This is a competitively priced cream that can tackle dullness and dark spots with niacinamide (5%), vit c derivative stabilized/boosted by ferulic acid, arbutin, glutathione and plant extracts plus hydrate and soothe with PDRN, beta-glucan, HA, allantoin, and glycerin. There is also anti-aging ubiquinone. While there isn't an added fragrance/parfum, it does have rose of Damascus water, which for some is fine, but for others can be an irritant. The cream itself is a lightweight texture and has a pleasant floral scent (it doesnt linger long though, thankfully). This would have been even better if it was unscented. The cream is very smooth and absorbs readily, leaving no greasy residue. For $25, this is definitely competitively priced!!

avis.titre: Nourishing, fragrance-free skincare
avis.texte: Quality ingredients, fragrance- and dye-free, with a non-tacky finish that I can easily layer with my other skincare products, SPF, or make-up? And under $30?! It's my new favorite. I have tried so many different day and night creams, serums, toners, etc in my almost 40 years, and this one truly stands out with how nourished and soft my skin feels. You only need a small amount to cover face, neck, and chest, so I expect even with daily use that this tube will last me 1-2 months, so the value is definitely there. I also like that it's a tube with an applicator pump as opposed to a screw-off top. I would gladly check out other products from this company based on my experience with this one.

avis.titre: Amazing product for dark spots!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this brand! I’ve purchased several other items of theirs and so far I really love them all! This product does not disappoint! You get a lot of product for the price with great ingredients! This is a pump tube 1.69 fl. Oz. It has a lightweight constancy. This is a brightening cream with glutathione and 5% niacinamide which is great for dark spots. Which is why I got this, it’s a little to soon to know if this will work, but with my research on dark spots this is a good product! This has plant derived PDRN and this helps repair and support skin barrier. It’s very hydrating leaves my skin so soft! So, you use this after cleanse and toner. It’s gentle enough to use morning and night. You want to make sure you apply sunscreen after applying this in the morning! This is such a beautiful product and I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Great for hyperpigmentation, evening skintone, and to get glass skin
avis.texte: Great quality and super effective formula from a trusted brand & I love this combo of ingredients — vitamin c, niacinamide, glutathione, PDRN, & centella. This cream does a great job of toning and brightening my skin, evening my complexion, helping fade my hyperpigmentation, gives a beautiful translucent glow, and deeply moisturizes my skin. It absorbs quickly and completely without leaving behind any residue, greasiness, pilling, or stickiness. It has little to no scent that I can discern, which I prefer since added fragrance can irritate my sensitive skin. This toning cream can be used as part of my pre-makeup skin prep (and it keeps my skin dewy and hydrated all day and helps my makeup apply smoothly and evenly) or as part of my nighttime skincare routine (it keeps my skin plump, hydrated, and glowy and I wake up the next morning with my complexion looking more even and very glowy, my hyperpigmentation spots lightened, and my skin looking clear and healthy.) It also doesn’t irritate my skin or clog my pores and I noticed the effects of this product right away (complexion evened out, hyperpigmentation lightened, and skin glowy and hydrated). I highly recommend this cream!

avis.titre: Lightweight lotion
avis.texte: This ROVECTIN Vita Double Toning Cream comes in a tube with pump. It has a light lotion texture with a slight scent (not fragrant) that absorbs easily into cleaned skin. For reference I am in my 40s, normal-to-oily skin type with hyperpigmentation. This lotion absorbs quickly without leaving my skin sticky to touch, nor it makes my skin feels too oily. It is light enough for me to use as a day lotion, along with serum and sunscreen. Overall, this feels like a nice lotion, I am happy with it. Made in Korea

avis.titre: Radiant Complexion, A Noticeable Transformation
avis.texte: This cream focuses on delivering a brighter, more even complexion with a combination of powerful ingredients and a gentle approach. It’s built around a core of glutathione and niacinamide, complemented by plant-derived PDRN for recovery and vitamin capsules for an added radiance boost. The intention is clear: to address dullness and uneven tone while also providing hydration and support for delicate skin. The inclusion of glutathione and niacinamide feels deliberate. These work in tandem to influence how the surface appears, aiming for a clearer look. The texture is noteworthy – it's lightweight and absorbs well, which is a plus. A heavier cream might feel restrictive, but this one seems designed for comfortable, daily incorporation into a routine. The fact that it doesn’t leave a greasy residue is a significant benefit, particularly for those who prefer a clean feel. The addition of plant-derived PDRN is interesting. It suggests an attempt to go beyond surface-level improvement and address potential damage. For those with skin that is easily upset, this could be a welcome component, offering a soothing effect. It’s not always about adding ingredients; it's about selecting ones that are unlikely to cause irritation, and plant-derived sources often align with that goal. The focus on barrier repair is also sensible, as a strong barrier is fundamental to overall wellbeing. The visible vitamin capsules are a clever touch. It's a subtle detail that adds to the experience. They are

avis.titre: Excellent lightweight toning cream for face, neck and hands
avis.texte: This is my first experience with Tovectin brand and so far, so good! This is the Vita brightening double toning cream and it is 1.69 oz but it seems like a much larger tube honestly. And a little bit goes a long way. I demonstrated it on the back of my hand as an older woman, I have crepey skin and I thought it would be a good demo of it and it was. The pump applicator itself I just had a prime it a little bit but the actual cream has a light citrus scent. That's very pleasant. It goes on very smoothly and absorbs quickly. The smoothing out of the crepey skin was fairly instantaneous and it feels nice, and not greasy at all. This would be a wonderful cream to use on your face and neck as well as your hands, as it's not a heavy cream, it's very lightweight and suitable for all skin tones. As we all know, a woman's hands are actually the best judge of their age. And oftentimes they are neglected in that regard. I look forward to trying more products from this brand as the quality is definitely there and so far, the immediate results have been very encouraging that longer term, will be even better. For the price and the size of the tube, I think it's an excellent value for your money.

avis.titre: Unsure about correcting dark spots but gives a nice glow
avis.texte: This cream feels very smooth and soothing on the skin without being oily or sticky. I've had no trouble applying this as the final step of my daytime skincare routine. It does not wipe away moisturizer I've already applied or peel off and make a mess. I have also applied foundation, concealer, powder, and blush on top of this without it rubbing off or reducing the efficacy of the other products, which is a big plus. I have been using it consistency as part of my daytime routine. I haven't noticed any evening of my skin, tone improvement, or lightening of some dark spots. However, it does give my skin a very nice and very subtle glow that I really like. I'm hoping with continued use to improve the appearance of my makeup-free face but even if it doesn't work, I really like the way it gives my skin a gentle, natural glow when applied.

avis.titre: Nice lightweight serum as long as you fully blend it in!
avis.texte: This product is a serum like texture and a little goes a long way. It does have a slight, clean scent, but is not overpowering. It absorbs well into the skin but wouldn't take the place of a moisturizer. It's lightweight on the skin without being oily or leaving any thick residue. The caveat I have is that if you don't fully blend it in, there seem to be these small, yellow granules in the product that can look kind of weird if you don't rub it in. I'm fair skinned and there wasn't any yellow tint once it was fully blended. It'll take time to see if it is effective in its claims, but first impressions seem promising. I also appreciate that it's vegan and has an expiration date several years from now.

avis.titre: great for spot treatment
avis.texte: This toning cream has a light, natural fragrance and is moisturizing while feeling lightweight on the skin. I incorporated it into my nighttime routine and woke up with radiant, glowing skin. I was truly impressed by the brightening effects of this lotion after just one use. The ingredients are equally noteworthy, featuring Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Centella, and Glutathione, all of which help enhance the skin’s barrier or brighten and tone it. I occasionally deal with hyperpigmentation and typically use a Vitamin C serum in my skincare routine. However, it’s refreshing to give my skin a break and soothe it with this moisturizing lotion that tones without being too harsh. I also find it effective for spot treatment; I apply a little more product to areas of discoloration and notice them brightening and fading over time. This product would be an excellent choice for anyone looking to tone their skin but who can't tolerate stronger active ingredients like retinol, glycolic acid, or pure Vitamin C serum.

avis.titre: Lightweight, hydrating and good quality
avis.texte: They had me at dark spot correction and evening out skin tone. I'm finding that as I age, these are two of my biggest issues. I'm thankful to have found a product that I hope can effectively help with both. It is a lightweight, moisturizing formula and absorbs quickly. It has a faint but pleasant smell. The texture is soft and creamy, not oily. I love that it is vegan, hydrating to my skin, and does not cause irritation. You get a good sized bottle at 1.69 fl. oz. This is a well-made product that uses high-quality, but gentle ingredients. I love the bottle design and the easy to use pump. The lid snaps on securely. A little squeeze goes a long way, so I think this will last me a long time. Considering the quality and benefits, I would say this is a great value. It would also make a great gift.

avis.titre: Good product!!
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by this facial toner cream, i actually really like it! Tube is very decent size for the price & came with tampering tape over the lid. The product is like a perfect water base cream, not too heavy but not so thin you cant feel it. It felt refreshing on my face and applied very smooth. I even put make up on over and there was no piling or issues at all! It's not oily, I have sensitive skin and this product felt comfortable on my skin. It absorbs well. I didnt smell any fragrance or scents. Long term use will have to see if it combats my dark spots but overall after initial use, im pleasantly surprised!!

avis.titre: Very gentle formula for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I’m really happy with this toning cream. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy on the skin. I have pretty sensitive skin and I didn’t experience any irritation, which is a big win for me!! What I noticed the most is how much brighter and more even my skin looks. I had some dullness and a few dark spots from old breakouts, and while they haven’t vanished overnight, they definitely look lighter. It’s also very hydrating, but in a soft, gentle way..not too rich or sticky. It layers well under sunscreen and makeup too. A little goes a long way and it works so I think it's a fair price.

avis.titre: Gentle Brightening Cream with a Silky Finish
avis.texte: The Rovectin Vita Double Toning Cream is lightweight yet super hydrating. I love how it melts into my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. I apply small amount before applying sunscreen & makeup because it gives an instant glow, and really helps with dullness and uneven tone. It feels soothing on my sensitive skin, especially after sun exposure, thanks to the plant-derived PDRN. Vegan, gentle, and effective, this cream leaves my skin soft, bright, and silky smooth, perfect for everyday use.

avis.titre: Fresh, Hydrating Cream with Trusted Ingredients
avis.texte: I was drawn to the ROVECTIN Vita Double Toning Cream because it includes PDRN, an ingredient I’ve had excellent results with before. This product arrives boxed and sealed with an expiration date, which gives confidence in freshness and quality. The packaging is practical—a pump tube that lets you dispense just the right amount without waste. The cream absorbs quickly, doesn’t irritate my skin, and leaves it looking fresh, bright, and hydrated. Overall, I’m very pleased so far and look forward to continued results.Another innovative Made in Korea product at a great price point for the quality and delivery system.
